absent: Locking, sleeping and concurrency rules for ptrace, quota, random, reboot, resource, romfs, rseq and rtc paths are not shown.
System call entry points, dispatch logic and kernel state machines beyond header constants are not shown.
Error codes, permission checks, capability requirements and user pointer validation are not shown.
Checksum algorithms, byte order helpers, time conversions and scheduler interactions are not shown.
Netlink transport, signal delivery mechanics and ioctl implementation behavior are not shown.

findings.text: Each user header carries a distinct include guard macro so repeated inclusion is idempotent and no guard is shared across files.

Classic tracing uses PTRACE_TRACEME meaning 0, then PTRACE_PEEKTEXT plus PTRACE_PEEKDATA plus PTRACE_PEEKUSR plus PTRACE_POKETEXT plus PTRACE_POKEDATA plus PTRACE_POKEUSR filling 1 through 6 respectively, then PTRACE_CONT plus PTRACE_KILL plus PTRACE_SINGLESTEP filling 7 through 9 respectively, with PTRACE_ATTACH meaning 16 plus PTRACE_DETACH meaning 17 and PTRACE_SYSCALL meaning 24.

Extended operations PTRACE_SETOPTIONS plus PTRACE_GETEVENTMSG plus PTRACE_GETSIGINFO plus PTRACE_SETSIGINFO plus PTRACE_GETREGSET plus PTRACE_SETREGSET plus PTRACE_SEIZE plus PTRACE_INTERRUPT plus PTRACE_LISTEN plus PTRACE_PEEKSIGINFO plus PTRACE_GETSIGMASK plus PTRACE_SETSIGMASK plus PTRACE_SECCOMP_GET_FILTER plus PTRACE_SECCOMP_GET_METADATA fill 0x4200 through 0x420d respectively in listed order.

Later extensions use PTRACE_GET_SYSCALL_INFO meaning 0x420e with PTRACE_GET_RSEQ_CONFIGURATION meaning 0x420f plus PTRACE_SET_SYSCALL_USER_DISPATCH_CONFIG meaning 0x4210 plus PTRACE_GET_SYSCALL_USER_DISPATCH_CONFIG meaning 0x4211 and PTRACE_SET_SYSCALL_INFO meaning 0x4212.

Syscall info codes use PTRACE_SYSCALL_INFO_NONE meaning 0 plus PTRACE_SYSCALL_INFO_ENTRY meaning 1 plus PTRACE_SYSCALL_INFO_EXIT meaning 2 plus PTRACE_SYSCALL_INFO_SECCOMP meaning 3, event tags use PTRACE_EVENTMSG_SYSCALL_ENTRY meaning 1 with PTRACE_EVENTMSG_SYSCALL_EXIT meaning 2, and PTRACE_PEEKSIGINFO_SHARED selects bit zero.

Lifecycle events PTRACE_EVENT_FORK plus PTRACE_EVENT_VFORK plus PTRACE_EVENT_CLONE plus PTRACE_EVENT_EXEC plus PTRACE_EVENT_VFORK_DONE plus PTRACE_EVENT_EXIT plus PTRACE_EVENT_SECCOMP fill 1 through 7 respectively, while PTRACE_EVENT_STOP means 128.

Tracing options use PTRACE_O_TRACESYSGOOD as 1, derive each TRACE fork, vfork, clone, exec, vfork-done, exit and seccomp variant by shifting 1 by its event number, place PTRACE_O_EXITKILL at bit 20 with PTRACE_O_SUSPEND_SECCOMP at bit 21, and define PTRACE_O_MASK as low byte plus those two bits.

Signal peek fields off plus flags plus nr order 64-bit start with 32-bit flags and signed count, seccomp fields filter_off plus flags pair 64-bit input index with output word, restart fields rseq_abi_pointer plus rseq_abi_size plus signature plus flags plus pad order pointer with four 32-bit words, and dispatch fields mode plus selector plus offset plus len quadruple 64-bit words.
Syscall detail header orders 8-bit op with reserved byte plus 16-bit flags plus 32-bit arch plus 64-bit instruction_pointer with stack_pointer.
Detail payload selects entry with number plus six arguments, exit with signed return plus error byte, or seccomp with number plus six arguments plus return data and reserved word.
Quota version is dquot_6.6.0 with MAXQUOTAS meaning 3, where USRQUOTA means 0 plus GRPQUOTA means 1 plus PRJQUOTA means 2.
Default quota file labels order user then group then project then undefined, matching type numbers with a trailing fallback.
Quota command encoding uses SUBCMDMASK meaning 0x00ff with SUBCMDSHIFT meaning 8, combining command shifted by eight with masked type.

Quotactl operations Q_SYNC plus Q_QUOTAON plus Q_QUOTAOFF plus Q_GETFMT plus Q_GETINFO plus Q_SETINFO plus Q_GETQUOTA plus Q_SETQUOTA plus Q_GETNEXTQUOTA fill 0x800001 through 0x800009 respectively in order.
Format codes use QFMT_VFS_OLD meaning 1 plus QFMT_VFS_V0 meaning 2 plus QFMT_OCFS2 meaning 3 plus QFMT_VFS_V1 meaning 4 plus QFMT_SHMEM meaning 5.
Quota block sizing fixes QIF_DQBLKSIZE_BITS at 10 and derives QIF_DQBLKSIZE by shifting 1 by that width.
Quota validity positions order QIF_BLIMITS_B as zero then QIF_SPACE_B then QIF_ILIMITS_B then QIF_INODES_B then QIF_BTIME_B then QIF_ITIME_B, with each single mask shifting 1 by its position.
Combined quota validity joins block with inode limits as LIMITS, space with inodes as USAGE, both times as TIMES, and all groups as ALL.

Disk quota fields dqb_bhardlimit plus dqb_bsoftlimit plus dqb_curspace plus dqb_ihardlimit plus dqb_isoftlimit plus dqb_curinodes plus dqb_btime plus dqb_itime order eight 64-bit measures with dqb_valid closing as 32-bit mask.
Next quota iteration repeats the base eight 64-bit measures with validity word then appends 32-bit dqb_id carrying the identifier at or after the key.
Information validity uses IIF_BGRACE meaning 1 plus IIF_IGRACE meaning 2 plus IIF_FLAGS meaning 4 combining into IIF_ALL.

Quota flag positions place DQF_ROOT_SQUASH_B at zero with DQF_SYS_FILE_B at sixteen plus DQF_PRIVATE next for kernel internal use, with DQF_ROOT_SQUASH and DQF_SYS_FILE masks shifting 1 by those positions.
Quota info fields dqi_bgrace plus dqi_igrace carry 64-bit grace times while dqi_flags with dqi_valid close as 32-bit words.

Quota warnings QUOTA_NL_NOWARN plus QUOTA_NL_IHARDWARN plus QUOTA_NL_ISOFTLONGWARN plus QUOTA_NL_ISOFTWARN plus QUOTA_NL_BHARDWARN plus QUOTA_NL_BSOFTLONGWARN plus QUOTA_NL_BSOFTWARN plus QUOTA_NL_IHARDBELOW plus QUOTA_NL_ISOFTBELOW plus QUOTA_NL_BHARDBELOW plus QUOTA_NL_BSOFTBELOW fill 0 through 10 respectively, separating hard and soft with block and inode plus below notices.

Netlink commands use QUOTA_NL_C_UNSPEC as zero then QUOTA_NL_C_WARNING with max sentinel deriving QUOTA_NL_C_MAX as one less, while attributes order QUOTA_NL_A_UNSPEC plus QUOTA_NL_A_QTYPE plus QUOTA_NL_A_EXCESS_ID plus QUOTA_NL_A_WARNING plus QUOTA_NL_A_DEV_MAJOR plus QUOTA_NL_A_DEV_MINOR plus QUOTA_NL_A_CAUSED_ID plus QUOTA_NL_A_PAD with QUOTA_NL_A_MAX similarly derived.

Random controls RNDGETENTCNT plus RNDADDTOENTCNT plus RNDGETPOOL plus RNDADDENTROPY plus RNDZAPENTCNT plus RNDCLEARPOOL plus RNDRESEEDCRNG share type R with numbers 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 7 respectively, where count controls exchange one integer, pool controls exchange two integers, and zap, clear and reseed carry none, skipping number 5.

Entropy provision fields entropy_count plus buf_size precede flexible buf of 32-bit words, while virtual getrandom fields size_of_opaque_state plus mmap_prot plus mmap_flags precede thirteen reserved 32-bit words.
Getrandom flags use GRND_NONBLOCK meaning 0x0001 plus GRND_RANDOM meaning 0x0002 plus GRND_INSECURE meaning 0x0004.

Reboot validation uses LINUX_REBOOT_MAGIC1 meaning 0xfee1dead with LINUX_REBOOT_MAGIC2 meaning 672274793 plus LINUX_REBOOT_MAGIC2A meaning 85072278 plus LINUX_REBOOT_MAGIC2B meaning 369367448 plus LINUX_REBOOT_MAGIC2C meaning 537993216.

Reboot operations use LINUX_REBOOT_CMD_RESTART meaning 0x01234567 plus LINUX_REBOOT_CMD_HALT meaning 0xCDEF0123 plus LINUX_REBOOT_CMD_CAD_ON meaning 0x89ABCDEF plus LINUX_REBOOT_CMD_CAD_OFF meaning 0x00000000.

Remaining reboot operations use LINUX_REBOOT_CMD_POWER_OFF meaning 0x4321FEDC plus LINUX_REBOOT_CMD_RESTART2 meaning 0xA1B2C3D4 plus LINUX_REBOOT_CMD_SW_SUSPEND meaning 0xD000FCE2 plus LINUX_REBOOT_CMD_KEXEC meaning 0x45584543.
Usage selectors use RUSAGE_SELF meaning 0 with RUSAGE_THREAD meaning 1 plus RUSAGE_CHILDREN meaning minus 1 plus RUSAGE_BOTH meaning minus 2 for wait use.
Priority bounds use PRIO_MIN meaning minus 20 to PRIO_MAX meaning 20, selecting PRIO_PROCESS meaning 0 or PRIO_PGRP meaning 1 or PRIO_USER meaning 2.

Usage fields ru_utime plus ru_stime as old timevals precede ru_maxrss plus ru_ixrss plus ru_idrss plus ru_isrss plus ru_minflt plus ru_majflt plus ru_nswap plus ru_inblock plus ru_oublock plus ru_msgsnd plus ru_msgrcv plus ru_nsignals plus ru_nvcsw plus ru_nivcsw as longs in order.
Native limit fields rlim_cur plus rlim_max use unsigned longs while 64-bit variant repeats the pair as 64-bit integers.
64-bit infinity RLIM64_INFINITY means all bits set, while stack ceiling _STK_LIM with lock ceiling MLOCK_LIMIT both equal 8 times 1024 times 1024.
ROM sizing macros ROMBSIZE plus ROMBSBITS plus ROMBMASK reuse block size with its bit width and mask as size minus one, while ROMFS_MAGIC means 0x7275 and ROMFS_MAXFN means 128.
Superblock markers combine bytes into words then words into long then long into big endian, yielding dash-rom and 1fs-dash identifiers.
Superblock fields word0 plus word1 plus size plus checksum order four big endian 32-bit words followed by flexible name bytes.
Inode fields next plus spec plus size plus checksum order four big endian 32-bit words with low type bits in next, followed by flexible name bytes.

Inode codes order ROMFH_HRD plus ROMFH_DIR plus ROMFH_REG plus ROMFH_SYM plus ROMFH_BLK plus ROMFH_CHR plus ROMFH_SCK plus ROMFH_FIF filling 0 through 7 respectively, with ROMFH_TYPE meaning 7 and ROMFH_EXEC meaning 8.
Inode header size ROMFH_SIZE is 16 with ROMFH_PAD as size minus one and ROMFH_MASK as negation of pad for sixteen-byte alignment.

Restart CPU markers use RSEQ_CPU_ID_UNINITIALIZED meaning minus 1 with RSEQ_CPU_ID_REGISTRATION_FAILED meaning minus 2, while flags use RSEQ_FLAG_UNREGISTER as bit zero with RSEQ_FLAG_SLICE_EXT_DEFAULT_ON as bit one.

Critical section bits reserve zero through two for no-restart on preempt, signal and migrate, leave three empty, then place slice availability at bit four with enabled at bit five, with mask constants shifting 1 by each position.

Critical descriptor fields version plus flags as 32-bit words precede start_ip plus post_commit_offset plus abort_ip as 64-bit addresses aligned to four words, while slice fields all as 32-bit whole overlays request plus granted bytes with reserved sixteen bits.

Per-thread restart fields cpu_id_start plus cpu_id plus rseq_cs plus flags plus node_id plus mm_cid plus slice_ctrl plus reserved byte plus flexible tail align to 32 with single reserved byte bumping size past 32.

Restart memory requires single-copy atomic reads by owning thread only, with kernel clearing code pointer on preemption or signal outside target and user clearing before reclaim, plus 32-bit ports updating low word leaving high zero.

Calendar fields tm_sec plus tm_min plus tm_hour plus tm_mday plus tm_mon plus tm_year plus tm_wday plus tm_yday plus tm_isdst order nine integers, while alarm fields enabled plus pending as bytes precede embedded time.

Phase fields pll_ctrl plus pll_value plus pll_max plus pll_min plus pll_posmult plus pll_negmult as integers precede long pll_clock, while parameter fields param with union uvalue or svalue or ptr as 64-bit views precede index with pad as 32-bit words.
Only low byte plus exit-kill and suspend bits are valid in the tracing option mask, so other bits must stay zero.
Trailing flexible arrays in superblock, inode, pool and restart records require explicit length checks from size fields to prevent overrun.
Numeric gaps in classic tracing, random numbers skipping five, and dispatch values out of source order forbid assuming contiguity when validating requests.
